messages:
maria: opened PR to consolidate the 'Error Reference: context trimming & fallbacks' section. Need two concise SDK examples (helper-based retry + raw curl) and a short Dedicated-deployment note. PTAL.
aj: will review. prefer public helper `with_retry()` in examples; only show raw header in the curl repro.
ben: wording fix: we do NOT log full original prompt on trim. Suggest: 'we log trimmed payload and an opaque request hash to link to original.'
sam: I'll attach a small curl + server log that reproduces a stream cut followed by a 429 on immediate retry. use it in repro section.
nina: please add a line about pinning legacy model variants for Dedicated/private control plane customers.
maria: updated PR: added sync/async SDK snippets using with_retry, switched logging wording per ben, added Dedicated note, and included sam's curl repro. also added one-line QA caveat recommending a quick regression pass on trimmed variant before enabling auto-fallback.
aj: left two tiny inline nits (comment clarity + show header in curl as `-H "X-RW-Retry: 1"`).
docs-bot: PR opened by maria ref issue #338 (errref context-trim). reviewers: aj, ben, sam.
maria: I'll make aj's tweaks and merge Thu morning unless anyone objects.
